findings.location: Pre-analytical Considerations — diurnal variation claim, ref [8]
findings.detail: Ref [8] is an Endotext book chapter (Anawalt B, Matsumoto AM, NBK279145, nih.gov) explicitly identified in the bibliography as 'no PMID — book chapter'. The diurnal-variation sentence tags it '[8, cohort]'. The correct tag for a narrative book chapter is 'mechanism_review', not 'cohort'. No numerical effect size from this reference is at risk of being miscredited, but the tag is wrong.

The inline cite '[PMC12143982, cohort]' tags a case report series as 'cohort'. A case report (or small case series) should carry the tag 'open_label', not 'cohort'. 'cohort' implies a prospective or retrospective observational study with a defined population.

PMC12143982 is cited inline as '[PMC12143982, cohort]' but has no numbered bibliography entry. All other references appear as numbered entries [1]–[9] with full citation details. The missing bibliography entry is a fidelity gap; the reader cannot verify author, journal, year, or title from the reference list.

summary: Section C is a thorough, well-sourced account of testosterone measurement methodology. Rosner 17090633 and Vermeulen 10523012 both verified correct (author, title, year, key findings, pregnancy caveat). Three minor findings: Endotext chapter [8] mis-tagged 'cohort' instead of 'mechanism_review'; PMC12143982 mis-tagged 'cohort' instead of 'open_label'; and PMC12143982 has no bibliography entry. No off-whitelist numerical claims, no reversed interference directions, no fabricated PMIDs, no omissions from the brief. Total 92 = threshold; PASS with findings flagged for remediation.
